dossier.scp_unleashed.268.title: Cap of Neglect
dossier.scp_unleashed.268.caption: SCP-268 at intake, on the hat stand it is now kept on.

page.title: Special Containment Procedures:
text: SCP-268 is kept on a hat stand inside a sealed storage container in a standard security locker. It is not to be worn outside approved testing.
A subject wearing SCP-268 must be tethered to an observer by a line they can both feel. **Observers are to keep a written headcount and check it against the roster, not against what they remember.**
Any personnel found wearing SCP-268 without authorisation are to be relieved of it at once. This is harder than it sounds.

page.title: Description:
text: SCP-268 is a flat cap of grey-brown herringbone tweed with a short stiff brim, of a plain British cut. The maker's label inside has been unpicked. The cloth is ordinary wool.

A person wearing SCP-268 goes unnoticed. Others do not lose sight of the wearer so much as lose interest in them. Their eyes slide past, their attention settles elsewhere, and nobody thinks to follow up.
The effect is not limited to people. Animals, guard dogs and several contained anomalies behave the same way. %rRecorded footage of the wearer is reviewed as empty until a frame is pointed out.%r
The effect ends the moment the cap leaves the wearer's head.

page.title: Addendum 268-1: Test Log
text: Test 268-02: the subject crossed a crowded canteen and took a tray from the counter. Nobody looked up.
Test 268-04: the subject walked through a breach drill in progress. The response team did not challenge him.
Test 268-06: the subject was left in a sealed room for six hours. Nobody came to let him out until the roster was checked.
No subject has reported discomfort while wearing the cap. Several reported loneliness afterwards.

page.title: Addendum 268-2: Provenance
page.text: SCP-268 was handed over by the unidentified courier noted in other files. The courier remarked that he had nearly forgotten he was carrying it. %rHe had been carrying it for eleven days.%r

jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp268_cap.1: SCP-268 is a grey-brown tweed flat cap of a plain British cut. The label inside has been unpicked. Nothing about the cloth is unusual.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp268_cap.2: Whoever wears it goes unnoticed. People and creatures alike look straight past them, and nothing the wearer reaches for seems to notice them either.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp268_cap.3: It cannot be crafted. Recover the SCP-268 dossier from an Archive Terminal and break its seal. A stranger in Foundation dress finds you and hands the cap over. It fits in a storage container.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp268.0: The courier hands the cap over in person.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp268.1: Count heads before and after every test.
